gate_results.title: Independent runtime and evidence tree
gate_results.summary: Static AST scan found only stdlib/local runtime imports, but no approved_asset_manifest plus full primary replay runtime trace exists.

gate_results.title: Gate seal precedes holdout inspection
gate_results.summary: Gate/architecture hashes match the seal, but primary holdout access lineage does not yet exist; this auditor is explicitly not the primary final-case auditor.

gate_results.title: Typed public event ledger
gate_results.summary: PublicEvent now requires source provenance and explicit occurred/recorded/available timing; observations additionally require sample/result timing and enforce order. Unknown types and untyped planned actions fail closed.

gate_results.title: Exact-once recursive replay
gate_results.summary: 36-test suite plus independent two-process replay verified exact canonical child bytes and query outputs with the content-addressed ledger proof; same-source alternate event IDs are byte-identical no-ops.

gate_results.title: One canonical shared state
gate_results.summary: Execution switches are part of model_digest. Topology-off, guard-off and fully enabled runtimes have distinct digests and reject each other's canonical states.
code_evidence: probe: unique_digest_count=3; both cross-switch queries rejected

gate_results.title: Frozen wire-state completeness
gate_results.summary: Neutral states pass the frozen architecture schema; rehashed cross_coupling/geometry edits fail closed, while history/factor/action/epistemic fields are reconstructed and consumed by updates or heads.

gate_results.title: No future-information leakage
gate_results.summary: Availability filtering is applied before consumption and the future-event invariant test passes.

gate_results.title: Planned/performed/result availability separation
gate_results.summary: Plan-only, performed, hold/resume/complete, stop, dose and washout paths are distinct and availability filtered.

gate_results.title: Typed positive and negative factor likelihood
gate_results.summary: Registered emissions have typed active/inactive likelihoods; reliable negative evidence produces signed refutation.

gate_results.title: Shared-source and clone invariance
gate_results.summary: Same source is the common-parent evidence unit; exact clones and different child factors with the same source do not change bytes or certainty.

gate_results.title: Factorial concurrent-process posterior
gate_results.summary: Exact factorial joint supports simultaneous high nonexclusive process marginals; 12-process boundary produces 8192 hypotheses.

gate_results.title: Independent process persistence
gate_results.summary: Process marginals persist independently under process-local evidence; no disease simplex renormalization is applied.

gate_results.title: Branch/organ-local modes and coupling
gate_results.summary: Per-process local modes and declared process/mode couplings affect forward dynamics.

gate_results.title: Mode-specific drift, guard and hysteresis
gate_results.summary: Same-coordinate mode drift, explicit guards, separated enter/exit thresholds and hysteresis ablation are executable.

gate_results.title: Support masking and action memory
gate_results.summary: Action memory/support dependence and lifecycle-specific rollout distinguish supported from unsupported twins.

gate_results.title: Runtime-connected branch geometry
gate_results.summary: Topology changes inference and planning in registered ablations and emits effect traces.

gate_results.title: Stagewise evidence-responsive diagnosis
gate_results.summary: Neutral directional likelihood behavior exists, but no primary holdout cut trace, sealed assertions or label-leak evidence exists yet.

gate_results.title: Closed-world forced-choice rejection
gate_results.summary: Unknown-process perturbation raises unmodeled/mapping residuals and exposes partial-answer abstention instead of a single forced class.

gate_results.title: Dangerous state-collision detection
gate_results.summary: Production collision detector finds opposite-response same-state worlds; supplying the witness to plan blocks an otherwise selectable identified action.

gate_results.title: Unobservable split abstention
gate_results.summary: No-separator path returns typed UNIDENTIFIABLE and collision-aware plan excludes the action.

gate_results.title: Local split, availability and migration
gate_results.summary: Separating event creates a local stratum split, applies only after availability, and migrates with explicit lineage.

gate_results.title: Old-scope non-regression after refinement
gate_results.summary: execute_local_refinement freezes and reruns diagnosis, natural forecast, every unaffected action rollout and restricted plan at abs_tol=1e-12; it reports per-query before/after hashes and fails closed on injected drift.
